add_paragraph: Luke took his MSc in the lab, graduating in 2022 with a thesis on ==gap-filling== the long holes that weather leaves in sensor time series.
The method he wrote became part of the lab's data pipeline, and it is still what the group runs before any analysis.
He is now a Data Scientist at the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science (Eawag).
